artworks.title: Plate 49: Marmot, Hamsters, Rat, Field Mouse, Shrew, and a Coatimundi
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows various animals positioned around a twisted tree in an oval frame on a blank background. The animals include a beaver, a mole, several mice, a stoat, a fox, and others. There are Latin inscriptions both above and below the animals. The painting is highly detailed, with each animal finely illustrated.

artworks.title: Plate 50: A Crocodile, a Hippopotomus, a Land Crocodile or Tegu Lizard(?), and a Crocodile or Spiny-Tailed Lizard with a Papyrus Plant
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a riverbank scene featuring several animals. The crocodile is on the bank of a river under a gentle curve of green plants, with a boar and two lizards against a backdrop of water and tall grasses. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame. The crocodile is in the foreground, its textured scales rendered in detail, while the river reflects a light blue hue. A boar grazes on the green terrain, and tall grasses and palm-like plants set the boundary between land and the river. Latin inscriptions are above the oval frame. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Plate 51: Two Sand Lizards, a Common Parsley Frog(?), and a Caterpillar
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 52: Two Sand Lizards
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This image depicts two realistically rendered lizards positioned side by side within an oval frame. One lizard is darker with green hues, while the other is paler with yellowish tones. Both creatures are detailed, showing realistic textures of scales and limb structures. The background is plain, focusing on the lizards. Text is present above and below the oval, written in an old script, along with a Roman numeral (LII) on the right side. The composition suggests a study of the reptiles emphasizing observation and classification.

artworks.title: Plate 53: Two Common or Mediterranean Chameleons above San Sebastián, Spain
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Two chameleons are depicted in the image. One chameleon is on a branch stretching from the left, while the other is clinging to an intersecting branch below. The color palette consists of greyish-brown for the chameleons, soft green and brown tones for the tree branches, and light blues and greens for the background landscape. The background shows a coastal scene with rolling hills and water. The branches with the chameleons extend from the left side to the center of the image, with the landscape in the background featuring the horizon on the right side and mountainous terrain on the left.

artworks.title: Plate 54: Frogs, Lizards, and Salamanders(?) in a Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image is presented from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is not prominently defined due to the circular framing of the artwork. In the distance, rocky hills are visible. The drawing features detailed and delicate brushstrokes capturing the textures of barren tree branches, rugged rocks, and still water. The color palette is earthy, with shades of browns, greens, and subtle hints of blue in the water. Closest to us, frogs and toads are depicted near the pond, with some in animated poses. Lizards and other reptiles are shown on the tree and ground close to us. In the distance, a small waterfall cascades down the rocks.

artworks.title: Plate 55: A Hermann's or Greek Tortoise, Two European Pond Turtles, and Two Fritillaria
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Three turtles are in the foreground, with one on its back. The color palette includes earthy tones of brown and green, with shades of black and a touch of purple from the fritillaria flower in the background. The turtles are on a patch of ground with an upward curve to the right, and there is a small body of water at the bottom edge.

artworks.title: Plate 56: Two Heads of Cabbage
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Two spherical objects resembling heads of cabbage are depicted in the image. They have pale purple and white coloring. The background is light beige. The smaller object is positioned slightly to the left and above the larger object, which is more to the right and occupies the foreground. A golden-brown oval outline frames the objects, with text located at the top and right side of the image.

artworks.title: Plate 57: A Snake, a Fire Salamander, and a Snakelike Creature with Two Legs
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various reptiles on a grassy patch. The image features three reptiles: a salamander-like creature on the left, a coiled snake in the center, and a dark lizard on the lower left. The background includes grass and rocks. Latin script frames the scene at the top and bottom. The drawing is detailed, depicting the reptiles realistically.

artworks.title: Plate 58: Asps and Vipers
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of six different snakes in various patterns and postures within an oval frame. Latin text above and below each snake serves as identifiers or descriptions. Each snake is numbered from one to six, matched with annotations around the illustration. The snakes are detailed with different textures and colors, emphasizing botanical accuracy and educational intent. The colors are mainly muted browns and earth tones, except for one gray snake. The composition highlights the diversity and characteristics of the snakes.

artworks.title: Plate 5: An Ox and a Camel
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This image features two animals, a cow and a camel, standing side by side within an oval shape. The cow is light brown with curved horns, while the camel has a shaggy coat and beaded ornaments around its nose. There is Latin text above the animals and in red below them. The drawing is detailed and delicate, capturing the texture of the animals' fur and the ground. The color palette is soft, with a blend of realistic detail and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Plate 59: Snakes and a Lizard
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of serpents and lizards. The image shows various species of serpents and lizards illustrated within an oval boundary on a plain background. Each serpent and lizard is labeled with numbers. The drawing includes a mix of serpents with different postures and lizards with distinctive bodies. Latin text is present at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Plate 60: Four Small Snakes
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays four snake-like creatures within an oval frame. Each creature is numbered and facing towards the center. Above the oval is a red Latin inscription, and below is a blue Latin text. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Plate 61: Four Snails
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays four snails, each with distinct features. The largest snail is positioned at the bottom center, with a light brown shell and a pale body. A medium-sized snail with a reddish-brown and cream spiral shell is located above it to the left. To the right, a slightly smaller snail with a dark shell and black body is shown. A small snail with a cream and brown shell is situated near the center left of the image. The background is a light off-white color, contrasting with the snails' earthy tones. The snails are arranged within an oval border on the page.

artworks.title: Plate 62: A Slug with Snails
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows five distinct snails and a slug arranged within an oval boundary. The largest object is a brown, spiral-shelled snail in the top right corner. To its left is a yellow-shelled snail with a silky sheen, and below it, a smaller snail with a pink-tinted shell. In the top left corner, a dark slug with a speckled body is visible. The color palette includes earthy browns, yellows, and soft pinks against a pale background. The snails and slug are evenly spaced throughout the image, oriented inward, around the central smaller snail.

artworks.title: Plate 63: Seven Snails
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting shows several snails. There are seven snails in total, some large and some small. Their bodies and shells are in shades of earthy tones such as brown, cream, and beige. The snails are arranged in a gold oval frame against the off-white background, with roman numerals on the right.

artworks.title: Plate 64: Leopard Slug, Ground Beetle Larva, a Rat-tailed Maggot, and Other Creatures
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows several objects, including a long spotted slug at the bottom center. Other objects include a dark segmented insect on the mid-left and a brown shell-bearing snail on the upper right. The color palette includes pale beige, brown, black, and hints of pink. The spotted slug spans horizontally, with the insect above on the left and the snail above on the right. Other small specimens are spread out in the image.

artworks.title: Plate 60: Leafy Spurge Hawkmoth Caterpillar, Gray Dagger Caterpillar, and Pupae
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of caterpillars on a branch. The central branch displays various stages of caterpillar life. The main caterpillar has black, red, green, and cream tones, while smaller caterpillars with vibrant colors are on secondary branches. A brown chrysalis and a cocoon are also present. The background is cream-colored. This is in the style of Maria Sibylla Merian, known for detailed renderings of insects and plants.

artworks.title: Plate 66: Lackey Moth Caterpillar, Figure of Eight Caterpillar, Grey Dagger Caterpillar, and Other Caterpillars
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays various caterpillars of different sizes and colors, each illustrated within an oval border. The color palette consists of brown, black, tan, orange, green, blue, and yellow hues. Positioned around the oval are several caterpillars, including a fuzzy black and orange one at the top right, a blue and yellow-spotted one towards the lower left, a brown and black-striped one in the upper left corner, a small green one at the top center, a light grey one with black spots towards the bottom right, and other smaller caterpillars with various patterns and colors. The Roman numeral LXVI is located outside the right side of the oval.

artworks.title: Plate 67: Large White and Small White Butterfly Caterpillars, Hornworm Caterpillar, Broom Moth Caterpillar, and Others
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Several multicolored caterpillars are placed across branches in a frame. The color palette includes browns, greens, blues, reds, oranges, and yellows. The caterpillars show various shapes, sizes, and textures, some fuzzy, some spiky. Roman numerals "LXVII" are labeled on the right side.

artworks.title: Plate 68: Leafy Spurge Hawkmoth Caterpillar, Mullein Moth Caterpillar, and Other Caterpillars
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows six caterpillars of varying sizes and colors within an outlined oval shape on a neutral background. The largest caterpillar, located at the top, is predominantly green with lighter green stripes. The other caterpillars exhibit colors such as black, yellow, and brown, with patterns of spots or bands in white or orange. The caterpillars are evenly spaced within the oval, with one green caterpillar at the top, three centrally located, and two at the bottom, including a small curled brown one and a hairy orange and black one.

artworks.title: Plate 6: A Variety of Oxen with a Ram and a Water Buffalo(?) by a Plane Tree
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a pastoral scene with various animals. It depicts four different animals enclosed within a circular frame made by two trees. Each animal is numbered. On the left is a sheep with large, curled horns looking towards the interior space of the circle. In the center, there is a dark cow marked as number 2, standing next to a light-colored calf marked number 3. On the right is a goat with long, curved horns. The background consists of a grassy area and sparse foliage, including a tree with broad leaves. The top and bottom of the image contain Latin text. The phrase at the top reads "Equus in quadrigis, in aratro bos," and the bottom phrase reads "Non nostrum onus, bos clitellas."

artworks.title: Plate 69: Emperor Moth Caterpillar with a Second Caterpillar on a Branch
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two large caterpillars on different branches. One caterpillar is yellowish-brown with blue and black accents, while the other is green with orange spots. The color palette is earthy with green, yellow, and brown tones. The caterpillars are positioned on the branches in the image labeled "LXIX" on the right side.

artworks.title: Plate 70: Worm, Centipede, Millipede, and Other Long Creatures
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
